Show me the evidence for the Bill with a lapsed event and a later recorded stage. What can and cannot be concluded?

At least two Bills fit that description. Two examples highlighted in the draft are:

- Seanad Electoral (University Members) (Amendment) Bill 2020: a Bill Lapsed Event is recorded on 29 January 2025; Committee Stage is also recorded on that date and again on 27 March 2025. The recorded status is Current. [f26–f28; f22]
- Protection of Private Residences (Against Targeted Picketing) Bill 2021: Fifth Stage and Report Stage are recorded on 4 July 2024; a Bill Lapsed Event and Second Stage are recorded on 8 November 2024; a further Second Stage is recorded on 1 May 2025. The recorded status is Current. [f34–f38; f29]

These records establish that the entries coexist; they do not explain the apparent inconsistencies or establish either Bill’s final outcome. “Current” is not proof of progress or enactment, and a lapsed event is not a certified final outcome.
